profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Amazon, AWS AI
profile.summary:
We're hiring in AWS AI :)
Message me if you're interested in learning more and I'd be happy to share details about my team and/or other initiatives in the organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborating with peers to leverage AWS AI capabilities to enable improvements to the Business / Customer interaction via AWS Contact Lens (https://aws.amazon.com/connect/contact-lens/)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am a member of the Geospatial and Imagery team at the Climate Corporation! We work to increase agricultural yields via Machine Learning, Real Time feedback and Data Driven decisions. Our goal is to ensure the food security of the future by making the world’s arable land more efficient. We’re bringing tech to farming!

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II, Selection Monitoring
positions.description: I am a member of the Selection Monitoring team at Amazon! We are at the core of Amazon’s retail business, and our systems help Amazon stay ahead of the curve by providing the broadest set of products to satisfy our customers’ shopping needs. Using massive datasets and the latest data processing technologies like Spark and Amazon EMR, we build tools and systems for the retail business. These aims to keep Amazon’s catalog comprehensive and competitively priced in order to maintain our position as the most innovative and customer-obsessed company in the world.

positions.description: Member of the DiCE FC Team within the Digital Commerce Platform. Developed a scalable platform facilitating payment processing for Amazon's digital content. Working to get the world their digital purchases instantaneously!

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Developed a solution built on the .NET Framework. This tool aided the product knowledge of the field sales teams of the client.

Familiar with the C# language based on experience automating business tasks and fulfil client asks. Developed in all layers of the Application, including Data Modeling, Data Access, applying Business Logic, structuring data for views through View Models and client side display. Applied knowledge of data structures to effectively transfer only a required amount of data, and sort the acquired data in an efficient manner within application. Used Aspose .NET API to automate the production of Office documents (ppt, xlsx, doxc, and pdf) as well as the export process designed to deliver to the end user. Utilized Team Foundation Services to manage Code Versions, and complete Gated Check Ins of personal work. SQL Language Proficiency to execute data functions as well as DBA activities. Built models in the Entity Framework to converse with the solution database. Applied traditional Data Modeling principles to create a Relational Database. User Interface design with Javascript and HTML with the MVC Razor view engine. Generated web forms and content display with cshtml. Used the jquery library in conjunction with the javascript language to facilitate user function and interaction within the site. Familiar with css class assignment and styling strategies. Worked toward responsive design approaches within layouts.

Managed a development team, delegating features across the team, and ensuring project pace was kept at an acceptable level. Taught more junior resources both general coding practice, and expectations for the solution. Ensured that proper global functions and variables were leveraged to keep project code maintainable. Facilitated client meetings to understand business need and subsequently define solution operation. Developed under the SCRUM project management structure.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Performed an individual research project pertaining to the topic of Hydrogen Production utilizing Ceramic Materials. Completed a full report of findings drawn from lab based testing of dopant levels within the ceramics. Data Modeling within MatLab to represent findings of Hydrogen Generation.

positions.title: Sales and Marketing Intern
positions.description: Focused on research of the Lubricant and Powder Coating Markets of the United States.	Determined best applications based on material properties. Exposed to a Business to Business Sales Marketplace.
